title: Pure sorptivity-versus-Darcy absorption selection and residual-event update

source.behavior: Use sorptivity only when AbsSorp is strictly greater than SorpFac*AbsDarc; otherwise select the Darcy-scaled term, zero the unselected residual, and keep the sorptivity event open only above the strict residual-rate threshold.

scope: explicit candidate terms, factor and reduction
100000 deterministic bitwise comparisons at O0/O2 including equality
non_goals: ABSORPTION state/workspace ownership or Darcy candidate construction
accepted mass receipt, rollback/restart or runtime admission
